answer: Like mycelium binding living soil while letting hollow chaff rot, decentralized consensus weeds out impostors through transitive trust staking. Every valid agent ties identity to a web of bonded interactions; a lone attacker cannot mimic deep roots. Instead of relying on a static relic or fluttering like an unvouched sparrow, nodes must lock collateral across expanding peer hops. Fabricating colluding identities imposes an exponential cost on the adversary, ensuring synthetic swarms collapse under compounding collateral burdens.
